what: On first open, a veil (deep stage color, with a brush-stroke Lottie drawn inside) covers the full-screen Hero plate, and when the art finishes (hold 2.34s or fx:art-done) the veil lifts in .15s with no easing, then .3s later bands of the background color grow from all four screen edges over .7s with cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) to the plate [data-fx-part=frame] slot’s frame. Meanwhile scroll is locked (Lenis is stopped and restarted via fx:lock·fx:unlock), html.fx-intro-done is added at 1s and fx:done is fired, and the band and curtain are lifted at 1.2s — the header and side pillars outside the frame turn on when they see this marker

options.hold: Time until the art inside the curtain finishes (seconds), default 2.34 (70 frames · 29.97fps) — if event, it waits for fx:art-done (or ends by itself after wait seconds)
options.wait: hold: maximum seconds to wait when event, default 12
options.delay: Seconds from when the veil starts lifting until the band grows, default .3
options.ready: Time from when the veil starts lifting until the lock is released and fx:done fires (sec), default 1
options.clear: Seconds until band and curtain are removed from the document, default 1.2
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: Cover layer over the panel (child) — holds the stage color and artwork (Lottie slot)
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Frame slot to close in on (child) — the difference between that box and the panel box becomes the thickness of the four bands. If none, bands are 0

note: During the first intro the original hides everything outside the first screen with display:none so the board fills the screen. The caller hides the header and side column with html:not(.fx-intro-done), and hangs the entrance motion that fires after it all ends on that.

from.where: index.html .yg-hero (original HeroSection — after the 70-frame first-play Lottie, closing: curtain opacity .15s linear, white band top·bottom scaleY·left·right scaleX 0→1 .7s delay .3s [.4,0,.2,1], data-yg-ready at 1s, done at 1.2s)
